messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I finally fell asleep again I had one last dream.

output.original_text: When I finally fell asleep again I had one last dream.
output.joy: When I finally fell asleep again, I was delighted to have one last dream!
output.sadness: When I finally fell asleep again, I had just one last dream—it felt bittersweet.
output.fear: When I finally fell asleep again, I had one last dream, and it was terrifying.
output.anger: When I finally fell asleep again, I had one last dream, and it made me so angry!
output.surprise: When I finally fell asleep again, I had one last dream, and I couldn't believe what happened!
output.disgust: When I finally fell asleep again, I had one last dream, and it left a disgusting feeling.
